summary: A two-state icon button, in three shapes, with an optional press animation.

props.name: defaultPressed
props.description: Starting state when you are not controlling it. Pair `pressed` with `onPressedChange` instead if you are.

props.name: onPressedChange
props.description: Called with the new state. Required for a controlled toggle.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius. `squircle` uses `corner-shape`, which degrades to a rounded square where that is unsupported.

props.name: value
props.description: Identifies this toggle inside a `ToggleGroup`. When set, Base UI derives `pressed` from the group's own value array instead of this component's internal state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks the press and marks the control. The pressed state stays legible, so a disabled toggle still reports its value.

props.name: animated
props.description: The press-scale animation. Turn it off for an instant press, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The button has no visible text, so this is the only accessible name it gets. Set it every time.
